ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an equilateral triangle rolling along the outside of a unit square. One side of the triangle coincides with one side of the square, so the side length of the triangle equals the side length of the square, which is 1. A black dot is marked on one vertex of the triangle. The curved arrows in the figure indicate that each time it rolls, the triangle rotates around the currently contacted corner point of the square; the subsequent schematic diagrams show the triangle continuing to move forward along the outside of the square until it repeats. Reasoning: In the process of rolling from one corner of the square to an adjacent corner, the center of rotation is the current contact corner. The interior angle of the square is 90°, and the interior angle of the equilateral triangle is 60°, so the angle that can be turned on the outside is 360° - (90° + 60°) = 210° = 7π/6. Each time it rolls, the overall direction of the triangle advances by 210°. For the direction of the triangle to return to its original direction for the first time, n·210° needs to be a multiple of 360°; because gcd(210,360)=30, the smallest n=12. That is, the triangle has made 12 side-to-side rolls around the square, namely after 3 laps, the point and the triangle first return to the starting state at the same time. In these 12 rolls, the rotation pivot cycles through the 3 vertices of the triangle in order. The black dot is one of these vertices, so it is exactly the pivot 4 times, during which it does not move; in the remaining 8 rolls, the black dot is at a distance of the triangle side length 1 from the pivot, and moves along a circular arc of radius 1 and central angle 7π/6. The total path length is 8 · 1 · 7π/6 = 28π/3.

raw_record.question_text: An equilateral triangle is being rolled around a unit square as shown. How long is the path that the point shown covers, if the point and the triangle are both back at the start for the first time?

method.method_draft: Use a rolling-rotation count. First read the diagram: the equilateral triangle has a side coincident with a side of the unit square, so the triangle side length is 1; the marked black point is one vertex of the triangle; each shown roll is a rotation about the square corner currently in contact, and the arrow indicates the triangle goes around the outside of the square. From the text, use that the square is unit and that we must continue until both the marked point and the whole triangle return to the starting position for the first time. For one corner-to-corner roll, the side of the equilateral triangle changes to the adjacent side of the square, so the outside rotation angle is 360°-(90°+60°)=210°=7π/6. The triangle’s orientation advances by 210° each roll, so because gcd(210,360)=30, it takes 12 such rolls for the triangle orientation and position to repeat, i.e. 3 circuits around the square. Over these 12 rolls, the pivot vertex cycles through the 3 triangle vertices; the marked vertex is the pivot in 4 rolls and is stationary then, while in the remaining 8 rolls it is distance 1 from the pivot and traces a circular arc of radius 1 and angle 7π/6. Thus the total path length is 8·1·(7π/6)=28π/3.

图像描述：图中显示一个等边三角形沿着单位正方形的外侧滚动。三角形的一条边与正方形的一条边重合，因此三角形边长等于正方形边长，为 1。黑点标在三角形的一个顶点上。图中的弯箭头表示每次滚动时，三角形绕当前接触的正方形角点旋转；后续示意图显示三角形继续绕正方形外侧前进，直到重复。

推理：一次从正方形一个角滚到相邻角的过程中，旋转中心是当前接触角。正方形内角为 90°，等边三角形内角为 60°，所以外侧可转过的角为 360° - (90° + 60°) = 210° = 7π/6。每滚一次，三角形整体方向前进 210°。要三角形方向首次回到原方向，需要 n·210° 是 360° 的倍数；因为 gcd(210,360)=30，所以最小 n=12。也就是说三角形绕正方形走了 12 次边到边的滚动，即 3 圈后，点和三角形才同时首次回到起点状态。

在这 12 次滚动中，旋转支点依次循环经过三角形的 3 个顶点。黑点是其中一个顶点，所以它有 4 次正好作为支点，此时不移动；剩下 8 次滚动中，黑点距离支点为三角形边长 1，并沿半径 1、圆心角 7π/6 的圆弧运动。总路径长度为 8 · 1 · 7π/6 = 28π/3。
